title: NPPA releases Revised MRP for 543 brands of Anti-Cancer Medicines; List to be updated on continual basis; New Prices Effective from November 9, 2026
body_text: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) , under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers, has released a list of 543 brands of anti cancer medicines with their revised Maximum Retail Price (MRP). The revised MRPs will be effective from November 9, 2026 . The revised price list reflects the information submitted by companies up to October 27, 2026 and it will be updated as and when manufacturers submit their revised prices of non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs. (LINK) . The NPPA portal is updated on a continual basis. On October 17, 2026, NPPA had announced Trade Margin Rationalisation (TMR) of 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs in public interest to address excessive trade margins, make cancer treatment more affordable and improve access to anti-cancer medicines. Manufacturers were instructed to submit their revised list to NPPA. The 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs include immunotherapy medicines used in the treatment of over 20 types of cancer , Denosumab used by breast and prostate cancer patients , Pegfilgrastim used to prevent neutropenia in cancer patients, and Bevacizumab, which is approved for the treatment of colon, ovarian and cervical cancers. ***** PC/PM
